description: Source code for 'ptgen', a partition table generator tool, including functions for parsing sizes, converting sectors to CHS, rounding sectors, and writing partition tables to disk images.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the partition table generator, parses command-line arguments, and calls gen_ptable.

methods.name: gen_ptable
methods.description: Generates and writes a partition table to a disk image file based on provided parameters.

methods.name: to_kbytes
methods.description: Parses size strings with optional units (K, M, G) and returns size in kilobytes.

methods.name: to_chs
methods.description: Converts sector number to CHS (Cylinder-Head-Sector) format for partition table entries.

methods.name: round_to_cyl
methods.description: Rounds sector number up to the next cylinder boundary.

methods.name: round_to_kb
methods.description: Rounds sector number up to the nearest kb_align boundary.
